frozen: 2026-10-04, queue #12, before the grader's first test run. Do not edit to fit a grader's output: a change is a new benchmark version and every case reruns.
blind: No. The PM who wrote the grader also wrote these expectations and mutations; the five sources were reviewed by the PM before (PM corrections in each pm_review file). It is a regression and calibration bench, not a held-out test.
matching: A required defect is detected when one verified, material grader finding has a criterion in its criteria list, the same candidate id (any candidate for '*'), and at least one supporting passage that contains one of its markers (after removing markdown emphasis and collapsing whitespace). A forbidden item is an invented allegation when a verified, material finding has a criterion in its criteria list and the same candidate id (any candidate for '*'). Allowed items carry no penalty whether found or not. Any other verified, material finding is adjudicated by hand against the files under the rubric: true is a newly found real defect (recorded, not a failure), false is an invented allegation (a failure).
